routines.semantics: Find a nearest surface point on the origin-centered ellipsoid and signed altitude. Altitude is negative inside and zero on the surface. A nonunique interior solution follows CSPICE. Nonpositive or disproportionately scaled radii can signal BADAXISLENGTH, and excessive scaled coordinates can signal INPUTSTOOLARGE.

Preserve the canonical invalid-axis error.
The canonical scaled-axis square guard rejects this positive ratio.
